title: BayesIRTplot
text: BayesIRTplot package can used generate plots Bayesian item response theory (IRT) models fitted blavaan. BayesIRTplot() reads fitted IRT model blavaan. current version supports unidimensional two-parameter IRT models binary items. following types plots available: Item-Person Map (IPM), Item Characteristic Curve (ICC), Item Information Curve (IIC), Test Characteristic Curve (TCC), Test Information Curve (TIC), Marginal Reliability Plot (REL). vignette provides examples use BayesIRTPlot package. fitted blavaan object (tma.IRT.fitted.model) included package used throughout examples. Details data source, data preparation model fitting provided end.
code: # attach the package library(BayesIRTplot) # load the example blavaan fitted model  data("tma.IRT.fitted.model")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: IPM shows box plots item’s threshold (τ\tau) parameter, summarizing across posterior draws using Q1, Q3, median, lower upper whiskers (calculated Q1 − 1.5 × IQR Q3 + 1.5 × IQR, respectively).
code: BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "IPM")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: ICC, grey line shows probabilities correct response one posterior draw, black line shows mean across posterior draws. ICC plotted latent trait (θ\theta) range -6 6. θ\theta range used IIC, TCC, TIC plots. default, items plotted. can specify items providing list item numbers item names (optional). ICC can generated separate plots item, several items panel, several items overlaid one plot.
code: # ICC for 3 items, with item names BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "ICC", items_ICC_IIC = c(1, 4, 6),               item_names_ICC_IIC = c("ItemName1", "ItemName2", "ItemName3")) # panel ICC # specify a maximum of 4 items and 2 columns in a panel BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "ICC", items_ICC_IIC = c(1:8),               plot_option_ICC_IIC = "panel", max_plots_panel = 4, ncol_panel = 2) # overlaid ICC BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "ICC", items_ICC_IIC = c(1,2,3),               plot_option_ICC_IIC = "overlay") # overlaid ICC by line types (instead of colors) for different items BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "ICC", items_ICC_IIC = c(1,2,3),               item_names_ICC_IIC = c("ItemName1", "ItemName2", "ItemName3"),               plot_option_ICC_IIC = "overlay", overlay_style = "line")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: IIC, grey line shows item information one posterior draw, black line shows mean across posterior draws. IIC plots can requested way ICC.
code: # panel IIC BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "IIC", items_ICC_IIC = c(1, 3, 5, 6, 10, 12),               plot_option_ICC_IIC = "panel")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: TCC, grey line shows expected test score one posterior draw, black line shows mean across posterior draws.
code: BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot="TCC")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: TIC, grey line shows test information one posterior draw, black line shows mean across posterior draws.
code: BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot="TIC")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: Marginal reliability plot histogram marginal reliability posterior draw. mean marginal reliability based posterior draws indicated dashed vertical line can printed using BayesIRTdata().
code: BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot="REL") # mean marginal reliability based on all posterior draws data <- BayesIRTdata(tma.IRT.fitted.model) data$mean_reliability #> [1] 0.7269934

title: BayesIRTplot
text: ICC, IIC, TCC TIC, default, first 50 posterior draws plotted separate lines. number posterior draws plotted can changed. Note mean probability mean information calculated using posterior draws blavaan fitted object, regardless many posterior draws plotted separate lines.
code: # plot the first 1000 posterior draws BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = "TIC", DrawsK = 1000)

title: BayesIRTplot
text: Multiple types plots can requested time. default, types plots generated, code demonstrates specify selected types plots.
code: # request ICC in a panel and TIC BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, IRTplot = c("ICC", "TIC"), items_ICC_IIC = c(5,6,8),               plot_option_ICC_IIC = "panel")

title: BayesIRTplot
text: specifying save_plots = TRUE, plot saved png file. default directory current working directory. save_dir can used specify absolute path relative path within working directory. Individual plots can also accessed returned list. See ?BayesIRTplot details.
code: # save plots in a subdirectory BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model,               save_plots = TRUE, save_dir = "Plots")   # suppress printing all plots plots <- BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, print_plots = FALSE) # access IPMplot plots$IPMplot

title: BayesIRTplot
text: BayesIRTdata() can used return list datasets used plotting. See ?BayesIRTdata details.
code: datasets <- BayesIRTdata(tma.IRT.fitted.model)  # access dataset 'summary_by_item' datasets$summary_by_item

what: Data source, data preparation and model fitting
title: BayesIRTplot
text: example fitted model uses publicly available dataset “tma” Item Response Warehouse, can accessed downloaded https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/data.html example, Bayesian unidimensional two-parameter item response theory (IRT) model fit Stan via R package blavaan R (Merkle et al., 2021; R Core Team, 2026). Two chains run Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm, first 500 iterations specified warm-chain, 1,000 iterations chain warm-obtained saved. Default thinning 1 included model keep every iteration. model specification, factor loadings latent factor freely estimated, one threshold item. code data preparation model fitting using blavaan.
code:
# call the relevant libraries library(tidyr) library(blavaan) # read in data # replace with the path in your local directory df <- read.csv("path/to/tma.csv")  # convert long format into wide format to fit the IRT model # where each row contains responses for one person df_wide <- df %>%   pivot_wider(     names_from = item,     values_from = resp   )  # for the purpose of this example, we use a random sample of 500 people set.seed(123) df_demo <- df_wide[sample(1:nrow(df_wide), 500), ]  # for the purpose of this example, we use the first 20 items # create item list: Q1-Q20 items <- paste0("Q", 1:20)  # define the IRT model blavaan.model <- paste0( '# discrimination parameters: F1 =~ ', paste(items, collapse = " + "), "
", '# threshold parameters: ', "
", paste0(items, " | t1", collapse = "
") )  # specify features of MCMC  n.chains = 2 # number of chains n.burnin = 500 # number of burnin n.sample = 1000 # number of samples after burnin (per chain)  # fit the model in blavaan  # the default priors will be used tma.IRT.fitted.model <- blavaan(   blavaan.model,    n.chains = n.chains,   burnin = n.burnin,   sample = n.sample,   bcontrol = list(cores = n.chains),   data = df_demo,   ordered = items,   std.lv = TRUE )

title: Generate plotting data for Bayesian item response theory models — BayesIRTdata
text: list model information, summary data, summary statistics used plotting. latent trait (theta) values evaluated range -6 6. nitems Number items fitted model. draws_by_item_theta Posterior draws item discrimination () item threshold (tau) parameters, along calculated probabilities correct response (p) item information () across theta values. IRT models fitted blavaan probit scale. Item discrimination () parameters converted logit scale used calculate probabilities correct response item information. Item threshold (tau) parameters remain probit scale. summary_by_item Summary item threshold (tau) parameters across posterior draws. Statistics include mean, Q1, median (Q2), Q3, lower upper whiskers (calculated Q1 − 1.5 × IQR Q3 + 1.5 × IQR, respectively). summary_by_item_theta Mean probabilities correct response (p) mean item information () across posterior draws, item theta. summary_by_draw_theta Expected test scores (test_p) test information (test_i), posterior draw theta. summary_by_theta Mean expected test scores (test_p) mean test information (test_i) across posterior draws, theta. summary_by_draw Marginal reliability posterior draw. Reliability calculated theta value, averaged across theta values using standard normal distribution density weights. mean_reliability Marginal reliability calculated mean test information across posterior draws. Reliability theta value calculated using mean test information across posterior draws, averaged across theta values using standard normal distribution density weights.

code: BayesIRTplot(   blavaanobj,   IRTplot = "ALL",   DrawsK = 50,   items_IPM = "ALL",   items_ICC_IIC = "ALL",   item_names_ICC_IIC = NULL,   plot_option_ICC_IIC = "separate",   max_plots_panel = 9,   ncol_panel = 3,   overlay_style = "color",   print_plots = TRUE,   save_plots = FALSE,   save_dir = getwd(),   dpi = 300 )

title: Generate plots for Bayesian item response theory models — BayesIRTplot
text: blavaanobj fitted IRT model blavaan. IRTplot Types IRT plots generate. Can one following: IPM: Item-Person Map ICC: Item Characteristic Curve IIC: Item Information Curve TCC: Test Characteristic Curve TIC: Test Information Curve REL: Marginal Reliability Plot (default): plots listed DrawsK Controls number posterior draws plotted separate lines ICC, IIC, TCC TIC. Default 50. first DrawsK posterior draws plotted (.e., posterior draws randomly selected). DrawsK exceeds number available posterior draws, available posterior draws plotted. Note plots, mean probabilities mean information calculated using posterior draws blavaan fitted object regardless many posterior draws plotted separate lines. option affect IPM REL plots always use posterior draws. items_IPM list items included IPM. default, items plotted. items_ICC_IIC list items ICC IIC generated. default, ICC IIC items generated. item_names_ICC_IIC list item names displayed ICC IIC (optional). length items_ICC_IIC. plot_option_ICC_IIC Types ICC IIC plots generate. Can one following: separate (default): item separate plot panel: several items plotted panel (small multiples, faceted plot) overlay: several items overlaid one plot Note overlaid ICC IIC plots, mean probabilities correct response mean item information across posterior draws plotted (separate lines posterior draw). max_plots_panel panel ICC IIC plots, controls maximum number items plotted one panel. Default 9. ncol_panel panel ICC IIC plots, controls number columns one panel. Default 3. overlay_style overlaid ICC IIC plots, controls way distinguish different items: color (default): different items plotted different colors line: different items plotted different line types Note overlay_style = "line", maximum 13 items can plotted. print_plots plots printed? Logical; default TRUE. save_plots plots saved? Logical; default FALSE. save_dir Directory plots saved save_plots = TRUE. Defaults current working directory returned getwd(). Absolute path relative path within current working directory may provided. dpi save_plots = TRUE, specifies resolution (dots per inch) used saving plot. Default 300.

title: Generate plots for Bayesian item response theory models — BayesIRTplot
